name: hackyeah2026
description: Root task runner. Each app installs its own dependencies; there are no npm workspaces (RNOH expects node_modules next to apps/mobile/harmony).

scripts.backend:setup: python3.12 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -c backend/constraints.txt -e 'backend[test]'
scripts.backend:check: backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests && backend/.venv/bin/ruff check backend/src backend/tests && backend/.venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/src backend/tests
scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/mobile run lint && node apps/mobile/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c apps/mobile/.eslintrc.js --resolve-plugins-relative-to apps/mobile --ext .ts,.tsx packages
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
